items.label: Bird Away Device
items.value: This bird device create a disturbance to birds by reflecting light from the mirrored fan blades, preventing annoying birds from approaching, roosting or nesting. This is a combination of wide outdoor coverage, environmental protection and humanization

items.label: Polygonal Double-sided Blades
items.value: We adopts polygonal double-sided mirrored blade design, with an additional polygonal blade on the top of the head, which has a wider reflective surface, a larger range of areas and better effect. The blades can be disassembled and replaced, saving money and trouble

items.label: Outdoor-Grade Quality
items.value: The main body is made of outdoor-grade aluminum, which is corrosion-resistant and lightweight, suitable for installation in areas with fragile load-bearing. Plus inner stainless steel bearing for smoother rotation, and the adjustable neck can be bent 90-180 degrees to adapt to different installation needs. This reflector can provide large area of effective protection regardless of the weather

items.label: Easy Installation
items.value: Easy to install, comes with all the tools and accessories needed for installation. Ideal for installation on buildings, rooftops, boats, agricultural settings, gardens, patios, railings, signs or anywhere you need to scare birds away. Premium electroplated chrome finish, not out of place to install anywhere

items.label: After Sale Service
items.value: We are committed to providing customers with high-quality and practical products. If you have any dissatisfaction with our products, please feel free to contact us
